skills.name: Shape Revealer（释物之形/釈物の形）
skills.description: Kusuriuri attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Truth and Reasoning（道物之真理/物事の真理）
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
After an enemy takes a turn, Kusuriuri has a 40% chance of marking them with a Scale. Scales have a max of 3 layers. When attacking an enemy with Scales, each layer increases their damage received by 33%.
When the HP of an enemy with 1~3 Scales goes below 30%/40%/60%, all Scales will be Revealed for 2 turns.

skills.name: Defense（退魔）
skills.description:
Kusuriuri releases his sword and transforms into his inner self to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 263% of his ATK and marking them with a Scale.
If the enemy if Revealed, damage equal to 300% of the target's current HP (cannot exceed 600% of Kusuriuri's ATK) is dealt instead.
